found.truth_sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(addMonths(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Europe/Berlin'), 1)) AS m, sumOrNull(o.amount) AS v FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE toDate(addMonths(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Europe/Berlin'), 1)) >= toDate('2025-02-15') AND toDate(addMonths(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Europe/Berlin'), 1)) < toDate('2025-07-01') GROUP BY m SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
